rationale: No supported, non-redundant, safe optimization remains for this workflow. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is already implemented: the workflow declares concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true and a group keyed by workflow plus pull_request.number or github.ref, which correctly isolates distinct branches/PRs. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated: the ci job explicitly sets fail-fast: false with the comment "Here we want to see all errors, not just the first one," meaning full failure diagnostics are required (a listed contraindication); switching to fail-fast: true would cancel remaining matrix jobs and hide errors, reducing intended coverage. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is already present via timeout-minutes: 90 on the ci job, and there is no representative per-job duration history (CI history is marked not_a_measured_baseline and timestamps include queue time) to justify a different bound; lowering it risks false timeouts on valid slow runs, another listed contraindication. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already in place through the actions/cache entry for ~/.npm keyed on runner OS and package-lock.json hash, plus setup-node cache: npm. The remaining patterns (test/build selection, Bazel, environment reuse, etc.) do not fit this invoke/meson C++/Rust workflow or would weaken required coverage.
